section.content: The utility model provides a special demonstration board for artificial intelligence machine learning, comprising: shell, light and removal seat, the shell upper end inboard is equipped with the light, the shell inboard is equipped with the mainboard body, the shell lower extreme inboard is equipped with the carrier, mainboard body rear side is equipped with the back stay, back stay lower extreme is equipped with the connecting plate, the connecting plate rear side is equipped with the bracing piece, compares with prior art, and the beneficial effect of this utility model has as follows: through using epitheca and inferior valve, can splice fast and dismantle the casing, through using inside groove and sealed pad, can protect the mainboard body, through using the back stay, can support the mainboard body rear end, through using the seat of revolving, can adjust the extension length of bracing piece, and be connected last bracing piece and lower bracing piece simultaneously, through using the seat of revolving, can adjust the extension length of going up the bracing piece, and be connected last bracing piece and lower bracing piece simultaneously.

本实用新型提供一种人工智能机器学习用专用演示板，包括：外壳、照明灯以及移动座，所述外壳上端内侧设有照明灯，所述外壳内侧设有主板体，所述外壳下端内侧设有载架，所述主板体后侧设有后撑条，所述后撑条下端设有连接板，所述连接板后侧设有上支撑杆，与现有技术相比，本实用新型具有如下的有益效果：通过使用上壳以及下壳，能够对外壳进行快速拼接以及拆卸，通过使用内槽以及密封垫，能够对主板体进行保护，通过使用后撑条，能够对主板体后端进行支撑，通过使用旋座，能够调节上支撑杆的延伸长度，同时并对上支撑杆与下支撑杆进行连接，通过使用旋座，能够调节上支撑杆的延伸长度，同时并对上支撑杆与下支撑杆进行连接。

Special demonstration board for artificial intelligence machine learningTechnical Field

The utility model belongs to the technical field of demonstration boards for learning, and relates to a special demonstration board for artificial intelligence machine learning.

Background

The demonstration board is a common teaching aid for demonstrating and demonstrating teaching contents. However, some demonstration boards suffer from the problem and disadvantage of not being able to make lateral, height position adjustments, which may affect the teaching effect and the user experience.

First, the lateral position of some demonstration boards cannot be freely adjusted. In the teaching process, a teacher needs to adjust the position of the demonstration board according to the layout of a classroom and the sight requirements of students. However, the design of some presentation boards limits the range of adjustment of their lateral position, resulting in a teacher not being able to adjust the presentation to the optimal position, affecting the student's view and understanding.

Second, the height position of some demonstration boards cannot be flexibly adjusted. Students in classrooms have different heights and different sight heights. Therefore, the teacher needs to adjust the height position of the demonstration board according to the height level of the students so as to ensure that all students can clearly see the demonstration content. However, some presentation boards are not adjustable in design and cannot meet the needs of different students, resulting in the problem that the students may be blocked from view or inconvenient to view.

In addition, some demonstration boards suffer from material and quality issues. The quality and quality of the demonstration board directly affect the stability and durability. Some demonstration boards are poor in quality of materials and easy to deform or damage, so that the demonstration boards cannot keep stable positions. Not only does this affect the teaching effect, but also potential safety hazards may exist, so a special demonstration board for learning an artificial intelligent machine is needed to solve the above problems.

Disclosure of utility model

Aiming at the defects existing in the prior art, the utility model aims to provide a special demonstration board for artificial intelligence machine learning, which solves the problems in the prior art.

The utility model is realized by the following technical scheme: a special demonstration board for artificial intelligence machine learning, comprising: the illuminating lamp is arranged on the inner side of the upper end of the shell;

The inner side of the shell is provided with a main board body, the inner side of the lower end of the shell is provided with a carrier, the rear side of the main board body is provided with a rear stay, the lower end of the rear stay is provided with a connecting plate, the rear side of the connecting plate is provided with an upper supporting rod, the outer side of the middle position of the upper supporting rod is provided with a supporting rod, and the front end of the supporting rod is provided with a rear supporting plate;

The lower end of the upper supporting rod is provided with a rotary seat, the lower end of the rotary seat is provided with a lower supporting rod, the outer side of the lower end of the lower supporting rod is provided with a bottom beam, the outer side of the bottom beam is provided with a supporting bottom ring, the lower end of the supporting bottom ring is provided with a moving wheel, the inner side of the bottom beam is provided with a sliding groove, and the inner side of the sliding groove is provided with a moving seat.

As a preferred implementation mode, the shell is divided into an upper shell and a lower shell, the upper shell and the lower shell are fixedly connected through bolts, the inner sides of the upper shell and the lower shell are respectively provided with an inner groove, and the shell can be quickly spliced and disassembled through the upper shell and the lower shell.

As a preferable implementation mode, the sealing gasket is arranged in the inner groove, the inner groove is in sealing fit with the outer side of the main board body, the front end of the upper shell is fixedly connected with the illuminating lamp through bolts, and the main board body can be protected through the inner groove and the sealing gasket.

As a preferable implementation mode, the rear stay is fixedly connected with the inner side of the lower shell, the front end of the rear stay is provided with a sealing rubber cushion, the sealing rubber cushion is attached to the rear side of the main board body, and the rear end of the main board body can be supported through the rear stay.

As a preferable implementation mode, the connecting plate is fixedly connected with the rear stay through a bolt, the connecting plate and the upper supporting rod are of an integrated structure, and external threads are arranged on the outer side of the lower end of the upper supporting rod.

As a preferred embodiment, the outside of the lower end of the upper support rod is contacted with the inside of the upper end of the lower support rod, the upper support rod is connected with the lower support rod through a rotary seat, the inside of the rotary seat is provided with internal threads, the lower support rod is a movable mechanism, the lower support rod penetrates through the bottom beam and is connected and fixed with the movable seat, the extension length of the upper support rod can be adjusted through the rotary seat, and meanwhile, the upper support rod is connected with the lower support rod.

As a preferred implementation mode, the movable seat is movably embedded with the inside of the sliding groove, the bottom beam is fixedly connected with the supporting bottom ring, the lower end of the supporting bottom ring is fixedly connected with a plurality of groups of movable wheels, the whole device can be supported through the supporting bottom ring, and the plurality of groups of movable wheels can be convenient for moving the whole device.

After the technical scheme is adopted, the utility model has the beneficial effects that: through using epitheca and inferior valve, can splice fast and dismantle the casing, through using inside groove and sealed pad, can protect the mainboard body, through using the back stay, can support the mainboard body rear end, through using the seat of revolving, can adjust the extension length of bracing piece, and be connected last bracing piece and lower bracing piece simultaneously, through using the seat of revolving, can adjust the extension length of going up the bracing piece, and be connected last bracing piece and lower bracing piece simultaneously.

Drawings

In order to more clearly illustrate the embodiments of the utility model or the technical solutions of the prior art, the drawings which are used in the description of the embodiments or the prior art will be briefly described, it being obvious that the drawings in the description below are only some embodiments of the utility model, and that other drawings can be obtained according to these drawings without inventive faculty for a person skilled in the art.

FIG. 1 is a schematic diagram of a special demonstration board for artificial intelligence machine learning;

FIG. 2 is a schematic diagram of a rear view of a special demonstration board for learning an artificial intelligence machine;

FIG. 3 is a schematic view of the structure of the lower end of the support bottom ring in the special demonstration board for artificial intelligence machine learning;

FIG. 4 is a schematic view of the bottom view of a special demonstration board for learning an artificial intelligence machine;

In the figure: 100-shell, 110-lighting lamp, 120-main board body, 130-carrier, 140-upper supporting rod, 150-rotating seat, 160-lower supporting rod, 170-bottom beam, 180-supporting bottom ring, 190-moving wheel, 200-back stay, 210-connecting plate, 220-back supporting plate, 230-supporting rod, 240-sliding groove and 250-moving seat.

Detailed Description

The following description of the embodiments of the present utility model will be made clearly and completely with reference to the accompanying drawings, in which it is apparent that the embodiments described are only some embodiments of the present utility model, but not all embodiments. All other embodiments, which can be made by those skilled in the art based on the embodiments of the utility model without making any inventive effort, are intended to be within the scope of the utility model.

Referring to fig. 1-4, a special demonstration board for artificial intelligence machine learning, comprising: the lamp device comprises a shell 100, a lamp 110, a main board body 120 and a movable seat 250, wherein the lamp 110 is arranged on the inner side of the upper end of the shell 100;

the inner side of the shell 100 is provided with a main board body 120, the inner side of the lower end of the shell 100 is provided with a carrier 130, the rear side of the main board body 120 is provided with a rear stay 200, the lower end of the rear stay 200 is provided with a connecting plate 210, the rear side of the connecting plate 210 is provided with an upper supporting rod 140, the outer side of the middle position of the upper supporting rod 140 is provided with a supporting rod 230, and the front end of the supporting rod 230 is provided with a rear supporting plate 220;

The lower extreme of upper support bar 140 is equipped with soon seat 150, and soon seat 150 lower extreme is equipped with down bracing piece 160, and the lower extreme outside of down bracing piece 160 is equipped with floorbar 170, and the floorbar 170 outside is equipped with supports the bottom ring 180, supports the bottom ring 180 lower extreme and is equipped with the removal wheel 190, and the inside spout 240 that is equipped with of bottom ring 170, spout 240 inboard is equipped with removes seat 250.

The shell 100 is divided into an upper shell and a lower shell, the upper shell and the lower shell are fixedly connected through bolts, the inner sides of the upper shell and the lower shell are respectively provided with an inner groove, and the shell 100 can be quickly spliced and disassembled through the upper shell and the lower shell.

The inside sealed laminating of main plate body 120 outside that is equipped with of inside sealed pad of inside, inside and the main plate body 120 of inside and main plate body can be protected through inside and sealed pad to the inside bolt connection that passes through between upper shell front end and the light 110.

The rear stay 200 is fixedly connected with the inner side of the lower shell, a sealing rubber cushion is arranged at the front end of the rear stay 200, the sealing rubber cushion is attached to the rear side of the main board body 120, and the rear end of the main board body 120 can be supported through the rear stay 200.

The connecting plate 210 is fixedly connected with the rear stay 200 through bolts, the connecting plate 210 and the upper support rod 140 are of an integrated structure, and external threads are arranged on the outer side of the lower end of the upper support rod 140.

The outer side of the lower end of the upper support rod 140 is contacted with the inner side of the upper end of the lower support rod 160, the upper support rod 140 is connected with the lower support rod 160 through the rotary seat 150, the inner side of the rotary seat 150 is provided with internal threads, the lower support rod 160 is a movable mechanism, the lower support rod 160 penetrates through the bottom beam 170 and is fixedly connected with the movable seat 250, the extension length of the upper support rod 140 can be adjusted through the rotary seat 150, and meanwhile, the upper support rod 140 is connected with the lower support rod 160.

The movable seat 250 is movably embedded in the sliding groove 240, the bottom beam 170 is fixedly connected with the supporting bottom ring 180, the lower end of the supporting bottom ring 180 is fixedly connected with the plurality of groups of movable wheels 190, the whole body can be supported through the supporting bottom ring 180, and the plurality of groups of movable wheels 190 can facilitate the movement of the whole equipment.

Referring to fig. 1-4, as a first embodiment of the present utility model: in order to solve the problem that in the teaching process, the position of the demonstration board needs to be adjusted according to the layout and the sight requirement of a classroom, however, the design of some demonstration boards limits the adjustment range of the transverse position of the demonstration board, so that the demonstration content cannot be adjusted to the optimal position and the viewing is influenced, when a worker needs to adjust the height of the main board body 120, firstly, because the outer side of the lower end of the upper support rod 140 is contacted with the inner side of the upper end of the lower support rod 160, the upper support rod 140 is connected with the lower support rod 160 through the rotary seat 150, the inner side of the rotary seat 150 is provided with internal threads, when the worker rotates the rotary seat 150, the fixed connection effect between the upper support rod 140 and the lower support rod 160 is released, then the worker moves the upper support rod 140 upwards to the height to be adjusted, then rotates the rotary seat 150 and fixes the upper support rod 140 and the lower support rod 160, so as to adjust the upper and lower heights of the main board body 120.

Referring to fig. 1-4, as a second embodiment of the present utility model: further, as the lower support bar 160 is a movable mechanism, the lower support bar 160 penetrates through the bottom beam 170 and is connected and fixed with the movable seat 250, and the movable seat 250 is movably embedded with the inside of the sliding groove 240, when a worker needs to move the main board body 120 left and right, the upper support bar 140 and the lower support bar 160 drive the movable seat 250 to move inside the sliding groove 240, and move by taking the inside of the sliding groove 240 as a walking path, thereby completing the left and right movement adjustment of the main board body 120.

The foregoing description of the preferred embodiments of the utility model is not intended to be limiting, but rather is intended to cover all modifications, equivalents, alternatives, and improvements that fall within the spirit and scope of the utility model.
